title: Technical Documentation Writer (Fresher)
description:
**About the Role:**  

We are looking for a passionate and detail\-oriented fresher to join our R\&D team as a Technical Documentation Writer at Sioniq Tech Pvt Ltd. You will assist in preparing clear and user\-friendly documentation for our upcoming Jewelry ERP system. This role is ideal for someone who loves writing, learning about software, and explaining complex ideas in simple terms. You’ll work closely with our business analysts, developers, and designers to understand how the application works and present it effectively for end users. **Key Responsibilities:**  

* Creating Design docs, user manuals, help guides, and screen\-wise documentation for the Jewelry ERP.
* Write simple, clear, and structured content to help users understand product features.
* Collaborate with senior team members to gather information about modules, forms, and workflows.
* Prepare FAQs, tooltips, and basic walkthrough documents under guidance.
* Organize documentation for easy access and maintain proper versioning.
* Update content as the software evolves or feedback is received.
* Maintain consistency in tone, formatting, and terminology across documents.

 **Requirements:**  

* Strong command over English with good writing and editing skills.
* Ability to understand and explain basic software features clearly.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Word, Google Docs, or similar documentation tools.
* Eagerness to learn technical concepts and documentation best practices.
* Interest in working with cross\-functional technical teams

 **Preferred Skills**:  

  

* Completion of any certified course related to Technical Documentation or Technical Writing is preferable.
* Basic knowledge of ERP or software applications.
* Ability to create basic flowcharts or screen annotations.
* Understanding of software development life cycle (SDLC) concepts.

  

  

  

**Terms of Employment:*** Agreement Period: 3 Years from the date of joining (including probation).
* Probation Period: 6 Months
* During probation, working days will be 6 days a week.
* After successful completion of probation, regular working days will be 5 days a week

We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.


We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Experience with Service Now ticket management system

We are seeking a qualified and experienced HR Manager with an MBA in Human Resources to oversee all aspects of human resources and administrative functions at our nutraceutical manufacturing plant. The HR Manager will play a pivotal role in developing and implementing HR strategies, ensuring compliance with labor laws, handling employee relations, enforcing HR policies, and managing administrative tasks to streamline operations within the facility. **Key Responsibilities**:**HR Functions**:

* **Performance Management**: Support managers in the implementation of performance appraisal systems, setting goals, and conducting performance reviews.
* **Compliance \& Legal**: Ensure all HR practices comply with local labor laws and industry regulations, including workplace safety and employee welfare standards.

**Administrative Duties**:

* **Documentation \& Recordkeeping**: Maintain up\-to\-date employee records, contracts, HR documents, and signed NDA agreements in both electronic and paper formats.
* **Reporting**: Prepare and submit regular reports on HR metrics such as turnover rates, absenteeism, employee satisfaction, etc.
* **Inventory Management**: Oversee office supplies and other administrative resources to ensure the smooth operation of daily activities.
* **Communication**: Act as a liaison between upper management and staff, communicating policy changes and ensuring that all employees are informed about company updates.

**General Responsibilities**:

* **Workforce Planning**: Analyze staffing needs and make recommendations for improvements or adjustments to optimize workforce productivity.
* **Health \& Safety**: Promote a safe and healthy work environment by ensuring compliance with safety regulations and conducting regular safety audits.
* **Team Collaboration**: Work closely with other departments to foster collaboration and ensure HR policies support company goals.
* **Other Duties**: Perform any other related administrative duties as required by management to ensure smooth operations.

**Qualifications**:

* **MBA in Human Resources** or related field.
* Proven experience as an HR Manager, ideally in a manufacturing or nutraceutical setting.
* Strong knowledge of HR practices, labor laws, employee relations, and confidentiality agreements.
* Experience in developing and implementing HR policies, procedures, and NDAs.
* In\-depth knowledge of **Employee State Insurance (ESI)** and **Employees' Provident Fund (EPF)**, and experience in managing statutory compliances related to these schemes.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills.

title: Software Engineer II - Benefits
description:
**About Rippling**

  

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.85B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the Benefits Team at Rippling:**
----------------------------------------

  

Employers and employees spend over $5 trillion annually on benefits globally. These include products like health insurance, retirement savings plans, and various other employee benefits that help families navigate critical life decisions. Despite their importance, the benefits industry still needs to be updated, costly and confusing for users.  

Rippling is transforming this landscape by building the first modern multi\-sided marketplace that seamlessly connects brokers, employers, and employees with any benefit. Our platform powers the discovery, purchase, and utilisation of benefits products globally, making the experience easier, more affordable, and user\-friendly.

  

Our Benefits Vertical Includes:

**Benefits Platform:** Powers recommendations, payments, and our benefits eligibility engine.

* **Benefits Marketplace:** Features over 100 partners, providing various benefits options to meet diverse needs.
* **Rippling Benefits Products:** Natively built products that integrate into the overall platform, enhancing user experience and engagement.


The engineering team behind the Benefits vertical works on innovative, scalable solutions that shape the future of this industry. This role offers the opportunity to work on complex systems, contribute to impactful projects, and help build the future of benefits at Rippling.

**You will:**
-------------

* Engineer and maintain innovative, customer centric, high performance, secure and robust solutions
* Confidently ship large features and improvements with minimal guidance and support from other team members. Collaborate with the team on larger projects
* Solve technical problems of the highest scope and complexity of your team
* Translate high\-level business requirements into a software design; communicate the designs to the other developers in the team.
* Review and share feedback on code, features, technology, architecture, and designs. Drive the standards around code quality and testing across your product.
* Drive the technical roadmap and architecture for the team.
* Provide mentorship junior engineers on your team to help them grow in their technical responsibilities and remove blockers to their autonomy
* Act as the technical lead for your pod/team and drive large initiatives.
* Have exposure to business and technical leadership to strategize what can improve our revenue and our ability to scale rapidly

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or equivalent
* Minimum 3\+ years of programming experience
* Ability to exercise discretion and independent judgment in the performance of the duties
* Preferred experience in our technology stack\- Python, Django, React, MongoDB, AWS and GoLang
* Ability to thrive in an ambiguous environment by identifying areas of impact and independently pursuing them
* Infectious passion for solving real customer pain points
* Experience in building scalable distributed systems
* Experience in building critical platform pieces that help the product scale quickly.
* Bonus: Experience in marketplace platforms.

The Hans Foundation (THF), established in 2009, is a Public Charitable Trust that works towards creating an equitable society to enhance quality of life for all through the empowerment of marginalized and underprivileged communities in India. The Hans Foundation works for the Health and Wellbeing of remote and under\-served groups, with an additional focus on children, persons with disabilities and women. THF also works for holistic Education and Livelihood development of our communities. Our Two\-Fold Strategy involves identifying and working within Aspirational Districts and high poverty index in the North, North\-East and East regions within specific states, as well as catering to lower\-income and migratory populations in cities, through urban programs.

description:
Designation:


Location: India West Bengal JST, Rishra


Organization: Cellulosic Fibre \& Textiles

**Job Description:**
--------------------

#### **Job Purpose**


To manage PF, Pension, EDLI and statutory compliance operations, ensuring accurate processing, timely settlements, and full regulatory adherence

#### **Job Context \& Major Challenges**


Manage end\-to\-end PF, Pension, EDLI, and statutory compliance operations, including coordination with EPFO, PF Trust, auditors, and internal departments to ensure accurate processing and timely service delivery

**Challenges**:

* Achieving 100% KYC Compliance *(Aadhaar seeding for all members)*
* Ensuring 100% E\-Nomination Completion for all PF members
* Timely Processing and Disbursement of PF Loans
* Zero NC during RPFC Inspections

#### **Key Result Areas**

**Key Result Areas/Accountabilities**

 **Supporting Actions**

 **PF Operations \& PF Loan Management**

  

* Manage issuance of PF, Special and NR loans for all eligible employee, ensuring accurate calculation and disbursement as per company/trust policy.
* Prepare loan vouchers, loan statements, and ensure proper documentation with employee acknowledgment for audit purposes.
* Perform monthly reconciliation of loan disbursements, EMI deduction, recovery of loan amounts and interest with the Accounts Department/Trust Office.
* Prepare monthly PF contribution, EMI recovery, and interest recovery reports.
 **Pension (EPS) \& EPFO Compliance**

  

* Handle pension\-related claims (monthly pension, withdrawals, transfer, etc.) in compliance with the EPFO Act.
* Prepare and submit required EPFO forms (Form 4, 5, 7, etc.) accurately and on time.
* Fill and manage pension applications through the EPFO portal.
* Manage UAN generation, PF/Pension number allotment to the new joiners
* Ensure prompt processing and closure of pension claims, including special cases (e.g., death cases) as per management guidelines.
* Upload monthly ECR and Update NCP (Non\-Contributory Period) days and ensure accuracy in all statutory filings
 **Coordination with the EPFO Officials and**

**Ensuring 100% Statutory Compliance**

  

* Approve online PF transfer claims and ensure timely KYC updates and approvals through the EPFO portal.
* Submit documents to RPFC on time and maintain regular communication with EPFO/RPFC offices and PF Trust for updates and grievance resolution.
* Maintain complete and accurate records of all pension\-related documents for audit purposes.
* Coordinate and facilitate annual PF inspection, ensuring 100% compliance and documentation readiness.
 **Coordination with the PF trust and** **Ensuring 100% Statutory Compliance**

  

* Ensure compliance with PF Trust rules, EPFO guidelines, and statutory requirements.
* Coordinate with PF Trust for claim approvals, fund management, and policy implementation
* Process PF Trust claims (advance/withdrawal/settlement) as per Trust rules
* Prepare and submit periodic reports/returns to PF Trust and management
* Coordinate with auditors for PF Trust audit and ensure audit readiness
* Monitor PF contributions, interest calculation, and fund reconciliation with Trust accounts
* Maintain proper records for inspections and statutory audits
 **EDLI \& Insurance Management**

  

* Prepare monthly EDLI statements along with detailed entry and exit reports, and submit them to the concerned insurance office within the prescribed timeline.
* Prepare EDLI payment vouchers for the Accounts Department to enable timely cheque preparation and submission to the insurance office.
* Prepare annual group insurance statements for policy renewal and coordinate with the insurance office for renewal premium and revised rates.
* Prepare EDLI claim statements with required supporting documents and ensure timely submitted the claim for nominees of deceased employees.
* Maintain regular coordination with the insurance office for submissions, renewals, claims, and clarification of issues.
* Handle EDLI inspections as scheduled by RPFC and ensure full compliance.
 **PF Full \& Final Settlement, Annual Closing \& Financial Reconciliation**

  

* Update exit dates promptly upon receipt of exit letters and process full \& final PF settlement for all members as per policy.
* Handle annual retirement settlements and coordinate with PF Trust to arrange required corpus funds for timely disbursement.
* Perform annual PF closing, including reconciliation of member balances, interest calculation, ledger finalization, and preparation of closing statements in compliance with PF Trust and statutory requirements.
* Maintaining operative and in operative ledger.
* Calculate and deduct TDS on applicable PF settlements/interest as per statutory norms and ensure proper reporting.
* Generate and maintain PF passbooks for members, ensuring accuracy and timely availability.

Assist in attendance coordination, employee follow\-ups, and day\-to\-day HR operational activities.

Support the HR team in preparing HR letters, offer letters, internship letters, certificates, and other employee\-related documentation.

**Employee Coordination \& Engagement**

Assist in handling employee queries and basic HR\-related concerns in a professional and timely manner.

Coordinate with employees and departments for HR\-related requirements, updates, and follow\-ups.

Support employee engagement initiatives such as Fun Saturdays, team activities, celebrations, and workplace engagement programs.

Contribute to maintaining a positive and professional work environment.

**Administrative \& Project Support**

Provide coordination and administrative support for ongoing HR projects and initiatives.

Assist in organizing HR data, reports, and internal communication.

Support the HR team in improving process efficiency and maintaining proper records.

**Eligibility \& Requirements**

MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or a related field is preferred.

Strong interest in Talent Acquisition and HR Operations.

Good verbal and written communication skills.

Strong coordination, follow\-up, and organizational abilities.

Ability to manage multiple tasks and work in a deadline\-driven environment.

Basic knowledge of MS Office / Google Workspace.

Detail\-oriented, responsible, and willing to learn.

Professional attitude with good interpersonal skills.

Ability to maintain confidentiality of employee and candidate information.

**What You Will Learn**

Practical exposure to recruitment and candidate management.

Understanding of HR operations, onboarding, and employee documentation.

Experience in maintaining HR trackers and reports.

Exposure to employee engagement and internal coordination.

Professional communication with candidates, employees, and stakeholders.

Hands\-on learning in a fast\-paced professional services environment.

**Why Join Us**

Hands\-on exposure to real HR processes.

Opportunity to work closely with experienced HR professionals and leadership.

Learning\-focused and growth\-oriented work environment.

Exposure to recruitment, onboarding, employee engagement, and HR coordination.

Certificate upon successful completion of the internship.

Future growth opportunities based on performance and business requirements.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate should be enthusiastic, disciplined, and eager to learn. We are looking for someone who can communicate professionally, take ownership of assigned tasks, maintain proper follow\-ups, and contribute positively to the HR function.

title: Workday Functional and Product support
description:
**About the Job:**


We are an innovative global healthcare company with one purpose: to chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. We’re also a company where you can flourish and grow your career—with countless opportunities to explore, build meaningful connections, and stretch the limits of what you thought was possible.

**Position Overview**


Sanofi is seeking a **Workday Functional and Product support** to join our **Digital P\&C / People Services** team. This is a critical role responsible for the **functional ownership, optimization, and governance** of the Workday **Core HCM and Security framework** across a complex global environment.


You will lead the design, configuration, and continuous improvement of Workday Core HCM while ensuring **secure, compliant, and scalable access control models** that support Sanofi’s global and local HR operations. This position partners closely with HR, IT, Compliance, and Security stakeholders to deliver a seamless, secure employee and manager experience aligned to Sanofi’s strategic objectives.

**Main Responsibilities**

**Workday HCM Configuration \& Optimization**

* Lead the design, configuration, and enhancement of Workday Core HCM and security ensuring best\-in\-class integration with Compensation, Benefits, Absence, Time Tracking, and other downstream systems.
* Analyze and remediate existing Workday tenant configurations to improve global consistency, data quality, system performance, scalability, and user experience.
* Drive harmonization of global core data models while supporting localization requirements for countries and regions.
* Manage security impacts arising from new HCM configurations, releases, acquisitions, and organizational changes.

**Stakeholder Collaboration \& Requirements Management**

* Partner with global and local HR, Payroll, IT, and Security stakeholders to gather, analyze, and clarify complex functional and security\-related requirements.
* Translate business and compliance needs into effective Workday HCM and Security solutions while balancing flexibility, risk, and standardization.
* Act as a trusted advisor to stakeholders on Workday design decisions, tradeoffs, and best practices.

**Innovation, Releases \& Continuous Improvement**

* Stay up to date with **Workday releases, features, and best practices**, proactively identifying opportunities to improve functionality and controls.
* Lead impact assessments and testing related to Workday releases affecting HCM and Security.
* Support adoption of new features that enhance governance, automation, and employee experience.

**Tenant Management \& Environment Governance**

* Act as the functional owner of the Workday tenant, ensuring stability, consistency, and performance across all environments (Production, Sandbox, Preview, and Implementation tenants).
* Govern tenant\-wide configuration standards, naming conventions, transport rules, and promotion processes.
* Coordinate and oversee Workday release management, including preview testing, impact assessments, regression testing, and go‑live readiness.
* Manage tenant dependencies across HCM, Security, integrations, and downstream systems.
* Ensure proper usage of tenants for testing, training, and deployment in line with internal controls and best practices.

**Compliance, Controls \& Documentation**

* Ensure all configurations and security models comply with **regulatory requirements**, internal audit standards, and Sanofi governance policies.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation for HCM configurations, security roles, domains, business processes, and controls.
* Support audits by providing clear traceability of access models, approvals, and system controls.

**Experience**

* Minimum 5\+ years of experience in Workday HCM, HRIS product management, or digital HR transformation in a global organization.
* Proven experience across functional workstreams, PMO governance, vendor/partner management, and executive stakeholder engagement.
* Familiarity with Workday configuration governance and environment/tenant strategies; able to peer coach technical teams (Architect/Config leads) while holding functional accountability.

**Technical Expertise**

* Deep expertise in **Workday HCM configuration** and tenant remediation.
* Strong practical knowledge of **Workday Security**, including domains, business process security, roles, and access\-based controls.
* Workday HCM Pro certification preferred; Workday Security experience or certification is a strong plus.
* Experience integrating Workday with local HRIS and third\-party systems is highly desirable.

**Domain \& Business Knowledge**

* Strong understanding of **core HR data models**, employee lifecycle processes, and localization requirements in global organizations.
* Knowledge of HR compliance, data privacy principles, and access governance concepts.
* Ability to translate complex HR and security needs into pragmatic system solutions.

**Advanced Skills**

* Agile mindset and ways of working
* Project management and planning
* Application design and system integration
* Security and compliance of computerized systems
* Strong business acumen
* Collaboration and stakeholder management
* Ability to communicate complexity with clarity and simplicity
* Fluent in English

* Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.
* Enjoy a thoughtful, well\-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.
* Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high\-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender\-neutral parental leave.
* Opportunity to work in an international environment, collaborating with diverse business teams and vendors, working in a dynamic team, and fully empowered to propose and implement innovative ideas.

Progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. title: Offboarding Team Leader
description:
**Join our Team as a Offboarding Team Leader**

**Location: Gurgaon**

**Hours: UK Shift**

**About the role:**


The Mobile Onboarding Team Leader is responsible for the onboarding and implementation of Mobile Products \& Services for Onecom’s customers. The Team Leader will provide leadership to the Mobile Onboarding Team, this includes the day\-to\-day management of the team and has ownership of all processes that are required to support the successful onboarding of mobile services.


The Team Leader is responsible for championing service excellence for both internal and external stakeholders. This is achieved by consistently meeting departmental KPIs and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. By building collaborative partnerships with stakeholders and suppliers, the Team Leader will optimise operational processes and refine customer journeys to ensure they are seamless, efficient, and impactful.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Oversee the processing of customer Mobile Connections on all networks, to support sales order validation and provisioning across the Desk, Field and Enterprise Sales teams including; new connections, ports, upgrades and tariff changes.
* Objective and performance based KPI management, including performance management and personal development
* Employee HR management including sickness, capability, disciplinary/grievance, training and recruitment
* Provide detailed reports for, but not limited to, Sales Managers, to support understanding of workload (WIP), SLAs (orders/connections/targets)
* Act as the 2nd line escalation point for issues arising from Connections processes
* Engage with external customers to provide updates and guidance on resolution
* Ensuring lessons learned are documented and shared with key stakeholders to ensure process improvement
* Provide support, guidance and training for direct reports; ensuring the team have appropriate resources, knowledge \& support to successfully execute their workload
* Design and implement new processes to improve efficiency and productivity for the team, our customers and the wider business
* Implementation and training for new products, tariffs and processes
* Support and guidance for complex networks, sales and solutions queries (including complex project roll out)
* Act as a key liaison between the Company and its external providers to meet the requirements to successfully provision customer orders
* Act as a key internal stakeholder to drive engagement across the business, initiate and execute continuous improvement activities
* Support Finance with validation, investigating and resolution relating to any errors or issues that may have been caused during sales order process
* Produce Monthly Reports on team productivity, capacity and provide recommendations and actions to drive improvement
* Act as an operational stakeholder in integration projects, contributing to planning meetings, conducting 'as\-is' process reviews, and facilitating the delivery of training to ensure a smooth transition for the team.
* Act as the Subject Matter Expert and engage with appropriate project team when building new processes or system development (i.e. Salesforce)
* Supporting the Operations Manager (Operational Delivery) where necessary
* Any other duties as required by your line manager appropriate with the role
**What makes you a great fit:**

* Inspirational leadership, demonstrates success, promotes team responsibility

* Excellent communication skills; written and verbal
* Ability to build and maintain relationships at all levels
* Ability to motivate and drive a team to ensure they contribute to the overall success of the organisation
* Effective coaching skills – able to identify and support direct reports with training and guidance
* Performance manager – understands performance drivers, promotes self\-management
* Change management \- ability to work through an environment of change and effectively lead the Offboarding team through transitions beyond their control
* Excellent decision\-making skills, taking ownership and responsibility
* High level of commercial awareness – understands how their role and other roles impact the business
* Able to remain calm when faced with challenging situations and individuals
* Delivers an exceptional customer experience and inspires others to do the same
* Able to plan and effectively prioritise own and team workload to ensure deadlines are met
* Adaptability and initiative
* A self\-motivated and pro\-active approach
* Strong IT skills and use of programs including Excel, Word and CRM systems
* Outstanding attention to detail and accuracy
**Perks for our People:**

* **Holidays**: 18 days annual leave, \+ 6 public holidays
* **Other Leave**: 7 days casual leave, 7 days sick leave
* **Development**: In\-House Training Academy
* **Wellbeing**: Mental Health support

**Who we are:**


Onecom is an award\-winning provider of Communication Technology, trusted by UK organisations to deliver Simply Brilliant Customer Experiences.

 **ED\&I:**


We are committed to equity, diversity, and inclusion, and we encourage candidates to complete our equality monitoring form as part of the application process. Responses are anonymous and help inform our future initiatives.

Reference Code: JR\-0000104559


  
Embark on a transformative journey as Team Manager\-Know your Customer at Barclays, where you will play a pivotal role to manage operations within a business area and maintain processes with risk management initiatives. You will take ownership of your work and provide first\-class support to our clients with expertise and care.


Critical role covering, managing the BAU activity for the team to keep regulatory visible KRI within group risk appetite due to increased volumes of clients requiring refresh. Team Manager are responsible for managing the team, Monthly performance Assessment, Portfolio reviews along with other tasks \& responsibilities so that clients remain compliant with group policy on KYC Attributes.

* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub\-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organization’s products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organization sub\-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organization.

You may be assessed on key essential skills relevant to succeed in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.


This role is based out of Gurgaon.

* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise

* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.

Marsh Risk

We are seeking a talented individual to join our Training (Insurance Operations) team at Marsh Risk, a Marsh business. This role will be based in Mumbai. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.

* Support the maintenance and updating of training resources on the Marsh Training Hub on the SharePoint platform.
* Coordinate and support training sessions virtually and in\-person, including facilitation and workshop coordination.
* Assist in the creation of CPD reporting and tracking of mandatory course completions.
* Collaborate with centralized teams to design training content related to Marsh Risk.
* Where required, create process maps and training materials related to business systems and procedures.

**Onboarding Experience**

* Facilitate, coordinate and supplement onboarding plans and induction schedules for India roles directly supporting Australia and NZ, collaborating with HR and L\&D teams in Pacific to align onboarding with existing regional or enterprise frameworks and priorities
* Set up a regular review and update onboarding content.
* Provide coaching and guidance to managers on effective onboarding and colleague development practices.
* Ensure compliance with organizational practices, legal requirements and diversity and inclusion standards throughout onboarding
* Monitor and report onboarding metrics and KPIs to senior leadership to demonstrate effectiveness.
* Provide effective reporting of onboarding performance to senior leadership, enabling informed decision\-making

**Technical Training**

* Support exam supervisory requirements and accreditation processes as needed.

**What you need to have:**

* Minimum 10years of experience in learning and development or training roles.
* Demonstrated experience in designing and delivering digital and virtual learning solutions.
* Experience managing multiple projects and adapting to changing environments.
* Experience with onboarding and talent development initiatives.
* Familiarity with accreditation and compliance training processes.
* Demonstrated experience with Articulate, PowerPoint, SharePoint
* Strong work ethic and commitment to team success.
* Openness to coaching, self\-reflection, and continuous growth.
* Accountability and willingness to take initiative beyond comfort zones.
* Innovative mindset with the ability to inspire and think creatively.
* High ethical standards and integrity.
* Strong ability to understand learning needs, requirements and outcomes and design training that supports that need across a recommended timeframe
* Strong instructional design capability with experience building e\-learning content, using Articulate , Sharepoint, PowerPoint, and other Microsoft Office suite
* Proficient in digital learning platforms, including Workday, SharePoint, MS Teams, Zoom, and other generative AI tools.
* Excellent communication and facilitation skills for virtual and face\-to\-face training.
* Ability to build relationships and influence stakeholders across multiple teams in multiple countries
* Ability to work in a changing work environment and demonstrate flexibility and problem\-solving skills
* Should be comfortable with 6\.30am – 3\.30pm shift

**What makes you stand out:**

* Knowledge of insurance industry practices is advantageous but not essential.

title: Senior ERD Manager
description:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non\-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions\-driven, passionate change\-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world\-wide for a better future.

**Key Responsibilities**

 **1\.** **Program Implementation and Strategy Development**

* Lead contextual and market analysis to inform program design and transition strategies from emergency CVA to early recovery and resilience.
* Oversee implementation of MPCA, CFF, GCTs, and livelihood recovery activities in accordance with IRC ERD program strategy and Cash Relief Operating Procedures (CROP) and SCWG/MEB standards.
* Lead program implementation activities at all stages of project cycle by providing guidance and technical direction to officers, field staff and other sectors who include cash transfer in their design.
* Ensure strong integration between emergency cash assistance and sustainable livelihood pathways (VSLA, entrepreneurship, skills training, business grants).
* Ensure inclusive, participatory targeting with strong accountability and safeguarding mechanisms.
* Ensure the payment options guarantee the maximum level of protection towards the beneficiaries.
* Integrate climate\-smart, nutrition\-sensitive, and market\-driven approaches into food security and agriculture programming.
* Ensure program modalities are context\-appropriate, conflict\-sensitive, and responsive to beneficiary needs.
* Ensure that all CTP program activities are implemented, to a high technical quality, in accordance with the IRC CTP Implementation Procedure, and according to established minimum standards and/or quality benchmarks.
* Promote gender\-, youth\-, and protection\-responsive economic empowerment in line with IRC’s EA$E model.
* Support emergency preparedness and rapid response scale\-up when required.
* Collaborate with the ERD Snr Coordinator to shape strategic direction and expansion opportunities.
* Lead market systems and value chain assessments to identify economic recovery opportunities.
* Strengthening linkages with private sector actors, financial institutions, and local authorities.
* Promote inclusive financial services (savings, credit, digital finance) to enhance household and SME resilience.
* Support climate\-smart agriculture and sustainable local food production systems.
* Facilitate job creation and entrepreneurship opportunities targeting women and youth.
* Strengthen adaptive capacities and shock\-responsive mechanisms for vulnerable households.

 **2\.** **Grant Planning, Implementation \& Business Development**

* Develop and maintain detailed workplans aligned with grant timelines and strategic objectives.
* Provide direction and monitor staff in their implementation of the workplan and quality of technical activities, share relevant information and direction to improve quality and achieve timelines.
* Oversee budget utilization, procurement planning, and spending forecasts.
* Assist in managing program transitions, budget oversight, and procurement/spending plans.
* Ensure timely and high\-quality donor reporting (monthly, quarterly, annually).
* Monitor implementation progress against indicators and ensure quality benchmarks are met.
* Contribute to proposal development, concept notes, and technical design for recovery and resilience programming.
* Identify opportunities to expand ERD programming in stable states and diversify funding toward economic stability initiatives.

 **3\.** **Staff Management and Development**

* Directly support and functionally supervise CTP Officers and other staff engaged in cash transfer programming.
* Build team capacity in: Cash and market\-based programming; Livelihood recovery models; EA$E (VSLA, entrepreneurship, financial literacy); Market systems approach and conduct regular performance reviews and provide structured coaching.
* Foster a professional, respectful work environment, promoting teamwork and guiding staff to perform effectively.
* Maintain open and professional relations with team members, promote a strong team spirit and provide oversight and guidance to enable staff to successfully perform in their positions.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, including quarterly discussions and annual evaluations.
* Promote staff well\-being, model healthy work\-life balance, and respond to staff care needs appropriately.
* Supervise ERD Officers and field teams, ensuring clarity of roles and performance standards.
* Foster a respectful, inclusive, and accountable team environment.
* Promote staff well\-being and duty of care principles.

 **4\.** **Grant Monitoring and Reporting**

* Undertake regular field monitoring visits to assess progress and identify technical quality issues and/or other implementation issues, provide solutions and implement modifications as required.
* Ensure staff are adequately trained and undertaking effective data collection through post distribution monitoring, vendor monitoring tools, feedback mechanisms and other necessary data collection systems,
* Ensure all monitoring activities are fully documented, including systematic and timely data collection as required under the grant and for IRC M\&E purposes.
* Produce/contribute to IRC and donor reports as per set schedules (monthly, quarterly, and annually) on grant activities, indicators and achievements.
* Conduct regular field monitoring to ensure technical quality and compliance.
* Ensure strong Post\-Distribution Monitoring (PDM), market monitoring, and vendor monitoring systems.
* Support measurement of outcome\-level indicators such as: Income restoration; Business sustainability; Financial inclusion access; Household resilience
* Ensure community feedback and complaints mechanisms are functional and responsive.
* Promote adaptive management through real\-time data use and learning.

 **5\.** **Partner Identification and Management**

title: Human Resources & Office Administration Specialist
description:
**Who Are We?**




 Ultima Markets is a dynamic multi\-asset trading platform specializing in the fintech and forex sectors. Founded in 2016, we are dedicated to providing innovative financial solutions that empower our clients to excel in a competitive marketplace.
 



  





 Our platform offers access to over 250 CFD financial instruments, including Forex, Commodities, Indices, and Shares, catering to investors from all walks of life. At Ultima Markets, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment where innovation is encouraged. Our team members benefit from professional development opportunities and the chance to work with industry leaders in fintech. If you are passionate about driving change in the financial sector and want to be part of a growing company, we welcome you to explore your future with us!
 



  




* To learn more about our company, please visit our website: https://www.ultimamarkets.com.



  





**Key Responsibilities:**




**Employee Compensation \& Benefit Management** 



* Ensure accurate and timely payroll processing in compliance with statutory regulations, coordinating closely with finance teams and external vendors to maintain confidentiality and integrity.
* Oversee the processing of employee expense claims in accordance with benefit policies and internal financial controls.
* Maintain and regularly update comprehensive employee records within designated systems to support payroll accuracy and audit requirements.
* Monitor and implement updates to employee benefit plans in line with changes in Indonesian labor laws and company policies.



  





**Recruitment \& Employee Onboarding** 



* Manage the end\-to\-end recruitment process, including job postings, resume screening, proactive candidate sourcing, conducting phone screenings, coordinating interview schedules, and supporting hiring managers in candidate evaluation and selection.
* Coordinate end\-to\-end onboarding for new hires by preparing documentation, arranging orientation sessions, and collaborating with cross\-functional and regional teams (e.g. IT, HQ HR) to ensure a seamless integration process.



  





**General HR Administrative Tasks** 



* Manage accurate tracking and maintenance of employee attendance records via the designated attendance management system, providing regular reports to management.
* Administer employee leave requests and approvals, ensuring adherence to company policies and relevant labor regulations, with timely reporting to management.



  





**Office Operations \& Vendor Management** 



* Oversee smooth daily office operations, coordinating maintenance, repairs, and housekeeping services to maintain an optimal work environment.
* Manage procurement and inventory control for office supplies and equipment, ensuring operational efficiency.
* Liaise with office space vendors, service providers, and external contractors to effectively manage leases, contracts, and service agreements.
* Lead projects for new office locations, ensuring alignment with company requirements, budget parameters, and operational objectives, when necessary.
* Oversee all aspects of office setup logistics, including furnishing, utilities, and infrastructure readiness, to facilitate seamless transitions, when necessary.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience**



* Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.
* 5 to 7 years of working experience in HR administrative roles, preferably within the fintech industry; experience in the forex sector is a strong advantage.
* Familiarity with Indian labour laws, statutory payroll requirements, and HR compliance regulations is a must.
* Knowledge of payroll processing, employee claims management, office operations management, employee attendance and leave management, and end\-to\-end recruitment processes.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional and diverse teams.
* Proven ability to work independently with minimal supervision, as well as contribute effectively within a team setting.
* Detail\-oriented with a high level of accuracy and commitment to maintaining data integrity.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and consistently meet deadlines in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.

description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------


Are you a fresher passionate about building a career in Quality Assurance? At Kensium, we deliver cutting edge eCommerce and ERP solutions for global clients. As a Trainee Test Analyst, you will learn to ensure product quality across functional, UI/UX, and integration areas — while gaining hands\-on experience with industry leading tools, QA methodologies, and best practices. This role is designed for enthusiastic learners who want to grow into Analyst and Senior Analyst roles over time.


### **As a Trainee Quality Analyst, you will:**


* Learn and support the QA process across multiple projects under the guidance of senior team members.
* Assist in creating and executing test cases and test scenarios (primarily manual, with exposure to automation).
* Participatein requirement reviews to understand business and technical expectations.
* Identify, log, and track defects using QA tools, ensuring clear documentation.
* Collaborate with developers, project managers, and analysts to support smooth and timely releases.
* Continuously learn QA best practices, tools, and methodologies.

### **We’re looking for someone who is:**


* Highly detail\-oriented with a willingness to learn and grow.
* Curious, proactive, and enthusiastic about quality assurance.
* Familiar with basic testing concepts; exposure to tools like Selenium or Playwright is a plus.
* A good communicator who can clearly articulate issues and observations.
* Passionate about delivering quality solutions and exceptional user experiences.

### **Roles \& Responsibilities:**


* Support the QA team in ensuring end\-to\-end quality across Kensium’s client deliveries under guidance from senior team members.
* Understand business and system requirements and assist in translating them into clear and well\-documented test cases.
* Help prepare and maintain test cases, test scenarios, and basic test data for functional, integration, regression, and UAT testing.
* Execute test cases accurately and report results with attention to detail.
* Identify, log, and track defects using tools such as JIRA, ensuring clear reproduction steps and timely follow\-ups.
* Assist in validating defect fixes through retesting and regression testing.
* Collaborate with Developers, Solution Architects, Project Managers, and UI/UX teams to understand requirements and quality expectations.
* Prepare and share basic test execution reports highlighting test status and observed issues.
* Participate in sprint reviews, internal demos, and QA discussions to understand delivery and release processes.
* Gain hands\-on exposure to automation and API testing tools (e.g., Selenium, Postman) as part of learning and skill development.
* Follow established QA processes, standards, and best practices consistently.
* Proactively ask questions, seek feedback, and continuously learn new tools, techniques, and domain knowledge.
* Assist in identifying potential quality risks and escalating them to senior team members when needed.
* Stay updated on QA fundamentals, tools, and emerging trends through training and hands\-on practice.

### **Experience and Skills:**


#### **Minimum:**


* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail.
* Positive attitude, willingness to learn, and self motivation.
* Knowledge of Software Testing concepts through a formal course/certification.
* Understanding of QA processes, testing types, and defect life cycle.
* Basic familiarity with Test Management tools (Jira preferred).

#### **Minimum Qualifications:**


* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field.
* Completion of a Software Testing course (mandatory).

### **What’s in it for you?**


* Accelerated learning environment with mentorship from experienced QA Analysts and Senior Analysts.
* Exposure to ERP and eCommerce quality assurance—aligned with Kensium’s Analyst career path.

Career growth into Analyst* Senior Analyst roles with clear competency milestones.
* Competitive benefits, learning programs, and a collaborative culture.

title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description:
Mechanical Design Engineer (Fresher)

* Job Description

We are seeking a motivated and enthusiastic **Fresher Mechanical Design Engineer** to join our team, specializing in the design and development of industrial **filling and packaging machinery**. This entry\-level role is ideal for a recent graduate with a strong foundation in mechanical engineering principles, CAD software, and a passion for machine design, automation, and manufacturing processes. The successful candidate will work under the guidance of senior engineers to contribute to all phases of the product lifecycle, from concept and detailed design to testing and final implementation.

* Key Roles and Responsibilities

The primary responsibilities of the Fresher Mechanical Design Engineer will involve supporting the engineering team in various design and documentation tasks:

1\. Design and Drafting Support

* **3D Modeling and 2D Drafting:** Create and modify detailed **3D models** and **2D engineering drawings** of machine components, sub\-assemblies, and complete machine layouts using CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Inventor).
* **Component Selection:** Assist in the selection of standard mechanical components such as motors, gears, bearings, pneumatics, and fasteners, ensuring they meet design specifications and industry standards.
* **Design Documentation:** Maintain and update the engineering documentation library, including Bills of Materials (**BOMs**), assembly instructions, and technical specifications for manufacturing.

2\. Analysis and Optimization

* **Basic Calculations:** Perform fundamental engineering calculations (e.g., stress, strain, tolerance, material strength) to validate design integrity and functionality.
* **Tolerance Stacks:** Conduct **tolerance analysis** to ensure proper fit and function between mating parts, focusing on designs for manufacturability and assembly (**DFMA**).
* **Prototyping Assistance:** Support the engineering team during the prototyping and initial build phase, observing and reporting on machine performance and identifying areas for design improvement.

3\. Manufacturing and Quality Liaison

* **Supplier Interaction:** Work with procurement and external suppliers to review component specifications and ensure timely delivery of parts according to design requirements.
* **Shop Floor Support:** Act as a technical resource for the production and assembly teams, addressing design\-related queries and providing clarification on engineering drawings.
* **Quality Checks:** Participate in the inspection and testing of finished components and assemblies to confirm they adhere to the design specifications and quality standards.

4\. Continuous Improvement and Learning

* **Standards Compliance:** Learn and adhere to industry\-specific safety, hygiene, and performance standards relevant to food/beverage and pharmaceutical packaging equipment (e.g., **FDA, GMP**).
* **Problem\-Solving:** Assist senior engineers in investigating and resolving mechanical failures, performance issues, and root cause analysis during testing or field deployment.
* **Documentation:** Prepare technical reports, design review presentations, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) as required.

Qualifications

Education and Experience

* **Bachelor's degree** in Mechanical Engineering or a related field from an accredited institution.
* **No prior full\-time industry experience required** (0\-1 year of experience is acceptable, including relevant internships or academic projects).

Technical Skills

* Proficiency in at least one major **3D CAD software** (e.g., **Onshape,** SolidWorks, Inventor, CATIA).
* Strong understanding of **GD\&T** (Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing) principles.
* Solid knowledge of mechanical engineering fundamentals, including **statics, dynamics, material science**, and **machine design**.
* Familiarity with manufacturing processes such as **CNC machining, welding, sheet metal fabrication**, and various surface treatments.

Soft Skills

* Excellent **written and verbal communication** skills.
* Strong **problem\-solving** and analytical abilities with a keen attention to detail.
* Ability to **work collaboratively** in a team environment and take direction from senior staff.
* Proactive attitude and a strong desire to learn and take ownership of tasks.

This role offers an excellent opportunity to gain practical experience in the specialized field of automated machinery design. Do you want to explore the specific technical challenges unique to filling and packaging equipment, such as high\-speed mechanics or hygienic design?

title: Tele Caller Executive - Morning & Evening Shift
description:
**Job Description**

**About Navpath**

Navpath Maritime Academy is a respected IMU CET coaching institute in Kottayam, training aspiring Merchant Navy officers. We are growing steadily, with new batches launching in July 2026, and are building a team that can match that pace.

**Job Role**

This is not a typical script\-reading telecaller role. We are looking for confident communicators who can take ownership of a lead from first call to confirmed admission. You will speak with parents and prospective students every day, build trust, answer real questions about a serious career choice, and convert genuine interest into enrollments.

You will also help us understand which leads are converting and which are not, so the team can adjust messaging and campaigns intelligently.

Morning Shift: 9 am \- 5 pm (Full Time)

Evening Shift: 5 pm \- 11 pm (Part Time)

**What You'll Do Day\-to\-Day**

* Call prospective students and parents from our daily lead list. Follow up consistently until they decide, one way or the other.
* Handle inbound calls and WhatsApp enquiries warmly and professionally.
* Counsel families on courses, fees, scholarship test, and the admission process. Handle objections calmly.
* Schedule and confirm campus visits, scholarship tests, and demo classes.
* Maintain a clean, up\-to\-date lead record — every call logged, every status updated, no lead going cold.
* Spot patterns in your conversations — which messages land, which objections repeat, which lead sources convert. Share these insights with the marketing team weekly.
* Support WhatsApp broadcasts and basic marketing activities when the team needs an extra pair of hands.

**Who We're Looking For**

* Fluent Malayalam and confident working English. You will speak to families across Kerala — clarity matters more than accent.
* Graduate preferred. Plus Two with a strong skill profile and proven communication ability also welcome.
* 1\-3 years in telecalling, sales, admissions counselling, EdTech, or BPO is preferred. Strong freshers who can demonstrate real communication skill are also encouraged to apply.
* Comfortable with target\-driven environments. Patient with parents, persuasive with students.
* Hands\-on with smartphone, WhatsApp, Excel or Google Sheets, and basic CRM tools.
* Honest, disciplined, ethical. We build relationships with families that last years — your conduct represents us.
* Willing to learn the maritime industry basics on the job, so you can speak credibly with serious aspirants.

**Skills That Will Help You Stand Out**

Candidates bringing any of these will be considered for broader responsibilities:

* Prior education or coaching institute experience
* Graphic design (Canva, Photoshop, Illustrator)
* Social media handling (Instagram, Facebook, reels)
* Content writing in Malayalam or English
* Basic video editing (CapCut, InShot)
* Working knowledge of any CRM or lead management tool

**Shifts Available**

* Day Shift: 9 AM – 5 PM (8 hours)
* Evening Shift: 5 PM – 11 PM (6 hours)

*Pay structures differ between the two shifts to reflect the hours. Please clearly state your preferred shift in your application.*

**What We Offer**

* Pay as per industry standards, based on shift, experience, and skill set.
* A well\-equipped, professional office at our Kottayam campus.
* Structured onboarding and training on our courses, audience, and conversion approach.
* Real responsibility from week one. As we grow, strong performers grow with us.
* A respectful, ethical work culture. We treat families well, and we treat our team the same way.

**How to Apply**

Email your CV to hr@navpathacademy.com or WhatsApp it to \+91 9400587885\.

In your message, please include:

* Your current location (to confirm commuting feasibility)

title: Android Developer (1 to 3 yr Experience)
description:
We are looking for an **AI\-First Android Developer** who builds production\-grade Android applications by working alongside AI agents and models — not by writing every line by hand.

The right candidate treats tools like Claude, Codex (GPT), and Gemini as primary collaborators for design, implementation, debugging, and shipping.

This is a strict **AI\-first role**. We do not want traditional workflows where developers copy\-paste code from Stack Overflow, hand\-patch bugs line by line, or hand\-write boilerplate. Code is authored, refactored, and reviewed through AI agents — the developer's job is to architect, direct, validate, and ship.

**What You'll Do**

* Design and ship production\-grade Android apps where the entire codebase is generated, refactored, and maintained through AI agents (Claude, Codex/GPT, Gemini, etc.).
* Drive features end\-to\-end using agentic workflows — break problems into specs, prompt the right model/agent, validate output, and integrate.
* Own GitHub\-based AI pipelines: CI/CD, automated PR reviews, AI\-assisted testing, and agent\-driven release workflows.
* Use coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, Aider, OpenCode, etc.) as the primary IDE — not as autocomplete.
* Architect prompts, context, and tool integrations (MCP servers, function calling, structured outputs) so agents can autonomously deliver features.
* Debug and fix issues by directing AI agents — never by manual copy\-paste patching of bugs.
* Integrate REST / JSON / XML APIs and web services through agent\-generated, well\-tested code.
* Design clean, Material\-3\-compliant UIs and let agents implement them; you review, refine, and ship.
* Improve app performance, cold start, memory, and battery using AI\-driven profiling and code generation.

**Must\-Have — AI Skills**

* Strong, hands\-on knowledge of AI agents and large language models — what they're good at, where they fail, and how to steer them.
* Daily working experience with Claude (Anthropic), Codex / GPT (OpenAI), and Gemini (Google) for real production code.
* Comfort with agentic coding tools: Claude Code, Codex CLI / OpenCode, Cursor, Aider, Windsurf, or equivalent.
* Prompt engineering for code: writing clear specs, providing the right context, using system prompts, structured outputs, and tool/function calling.
* Knowledge of MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and how to wire agents into real tools (GitHub, file system, build systems, test runners).
* Familiarity with GitHub\-based AI pipelines: GitHub Actions, AI\-powered code review (e.g., CodeRabbit, Claude/Copilot reviewers), auto\-PR agents, and agent\-driven CI/CD.
* Ability to evaluate AI output critically — catch hallucinated APIs, insecure code, and bad patterns before they ship.

**Must\-Have — Android Skills**

* Solid grounding in Kotlin (preferred) and core Java.
* Strong understanding of Android SDK, Jetpack, Coroutines/Flow, and modern architecture (MVVM / MVI, Clean Architecture).
* Jetpack Compose and/or XML layouts, with a working knowledge of Material 3 design guidelines.
* REST API integration and confident handling of JSON and XML payloads — including parsing, error handling, and retries.
* Git and GitHub fluency: branching, PRs, code review, releases, and Actions workflows.
* Ability to ship and own a project independently, end\-to\-end, from spec to Play Store.

**How We Work (Read Carefully)**

* AI\-first, always. Code is produced through AI agents. We do not pay engineers to hand\-type boilerplate or copy\-paste fixes from forums.
* No traditional copy\-paste debugging. Bugs are reproduced, described, and resolved through agent\-driven workflows with proper context and tests.
* Every PR is expected to be agent\-assisted, well\-tested, and reviewed by both a human and an AI reviewer before merge.
* You will be measured on shipped quality and velocity — not on lines of code typed.
* You are expected to keep learning new models, agents, and tools as the AI ecosystem evolves weekly.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience building or integrating custom MCP servers.
* Exposure to on\-device ML (TensorFlow Lite, ML Kit, Gemini Nano) or in\-app LLM features.
* Open\-source contributions, especially to AI tooling or Android libraries.
* Experience with Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) or Compose Multiplatform.

**Mindset We're Hiring**

* Sharp problem analysis — you can decompose a feature into something an agent can actually deliver.
* Strong ownership — you ship, you don't hand off.
* Curiosity — you actively try new models, agents, and workflows.
* Hungry for more responsibility and willing to commit long\-term to high\-visibility projects.

**Benefits**

* Flexible working hours.
* Month\-end parties, birthday celebrations, tours, and other cultural events.
* 4th Saturday off every month.
* Full access to paid AI tools and APIs (Claude, GPT/Codex, Gemini, and supporting agent tools).
* 12 days of annual paid leave plus festival leaves.
* A family\-style work culture — we treat the team as part of the S4ITTECH family, not as employees.

**Important Notes**

**Freshers:** you must already be comfortable with JSON parsing AND have real, demonstrable experience using AI coding agents (Claude, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, etc.) to ship working Android code. Please do not apply if either is missing.

**This is NOT a work\-from\-home role.** You will be working from our office.

**AI\-first is non\-negotiable.** If your workflow is still 'write code by hand, paste errors into Google,' this role is not for you.

title: NABH/QCI
description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for a dynamic and experienced Quality Manager with a minimum of 3 years of hands\-on expertise in implementing and maintaining NABH and QCI accreditation standards across all levels of healthcare delivery. The role demands end\-to\-end ownership of the quality framework—from policy drafting, process gap analysis, and documentation to leading internal audits and representing the organization during final assessments. The ideal candidate will be adept at driving a culture of continuous quality improvement and patient safety, ensuring full compliance with NABH 5th edition (or latest) standards, QCI guidelines, and applicable statutory/regulatory requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Accreditation \& Compliance Management**

* Lead the entire NABH/QCI accreditation cycle for hospitals, clinics, or specialized healthcare units (Entry Level, Progressive, or Full Accreditation as applicable).
* Interpret and operationalize all chapters of NABH (Access, Assessment and Continuity of Care, Patient Rights and Education, Infection Control, Facility Management \& Safety, etc.) and applicable QCI schemes (e.g., QCI for Ayush, clinical trials, wellness centres).
* Prepare, review, and update Quality Manual, SOPs, policies, and work instructions in alignment with NABH/QCI standards and local regulations.
* Serve as the primary liaison with NABH/QCI empaneled consultants, assessors, and accreditation bodies; coordinate pre\-assessment, final assessment, and surveillance visits seamlessly.

**2\. Quality Improvement \& Patient Safety**

* Design and drive hospital\-wide quality improvement projects using tools like PDCA, FMEA, RCA, and clinical audits.
* Monitor key clinical and non\-clinical quality indicators (HCAI rates, medication errors, patient falls, waiting time, patient satisfaction scores) and present actionable insights to leadership.
* Lead adverse event reporting, sentinel event analysis, and CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) implementation.
* Establish and manage infection prevention and control (IPC) programs in close coordination with the infection control team.

**3\. Internal Audits \& Training**

* Plan and conduct regular internal quality audits (clinical and non\-clinical departments) and mock drills to ensure 24/7 survey readiness at all levels.
* Train and mentor departmental quality champions, nursing staff, paramedics, and support services on NABH/QCI standards, documentation practices, and safety protocols.
* Organize ongoing competency\-based training sessions on BLS, ACLS, fire safety, hazardous materials handling, and waste management.

**4\. Documentation \& Data Management**

* Maintain a centralized document control system; ensure version control, periodic review, and easy retrieval of all quality documents.
* Use quality management software or manual trackers to log non\-conformances, audits, and improvement plans, ensuring closure within timelines.
* Prepare monthly quality dashboards and reports for management review meetings (MRM) and statutory submissions.

**5\. Patient Experience \& Regulatory Readiness**

* Implement patient feedback mechanisms; analyse feedback and drive service excellence initiatives to enhance the overall patient experience.
* Ensure compliance with Biomedical Waste Management Rules, AERB, fire NOC, and other statutory/legal requirements as applicable to healthcare organisations.
* Collaborate with HR in credentialing and privileging, medical records department for documentation integrity, and engineering for facility safety.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Hospital Administration / Healthcare Management / Nursing / Life Sciences.
* **Certification (highly preferred):** Certified NABH Internal Auditor / Lead Auditor, Diploma in Quality Management or Healthcare Quality from a recognized institute.
* **Experience:** **Minimum 3\+ years** of dedicated experience in a quality role within a NABH/QCI accredited hospital, multi\-specialty clinic, or diagnostic centre.
* **Proven track record** of successfully steering at least one full cycle of NABH/QCI accreditation or re\-accreditation across all levels (from gap analysis to final assessment).
* In\-depth understanding of the latest NABH standards, QCI framework, clinical governance, and statutory compliance requirements.

**Skills \& Competencies**

* **Technical Acumen:** Mastery of NABH (5th edition) standards and QCI accreditation processes, medical terminology, hospital operations, and patient safety science.
* **Audit \& Analytical Skills:** Ability to plan and execute internal audits, perform root cause analysis, and derive data\-driven decisions using MS Excel/quality dashboards.
* **Communication \& Training:** Excellent command over English and local language(s); capable of drafting clear SOPs and delivering impactful training to multidisciplinary teams.
* **Leadership \& Collaboration:** Strong interpersonal skills to influence across hierarchies—from housekeeping staff to senior consultants—without direct authority.
* **Resilience \& Detail\-Orientation:** Ability to work under pressure during survey periods, manage multiple priorities, and maintain an unwavering focus on micro\-level compliance.
* **Systems Thinking:** Skill in building sustainable quality management systems that go beyond accreditation and become part of daily operations.

**Work Environment \& Benefits**

* Full\-time, hospital\-based role with occasional travel for multisite coordination.
* Opportunity to lead accreditation for emerging specialties (e.g., NABH for Blood Banks, Dental Centres, AYUSH, etc.) and grow into Group Quality Head roles.
* Competitive salary commensurate with experience, health benefits, and continuous professional development support.

description:

* Validate deductions, fines, overtime, and recoveries.
* Coordinate with Accounts/Payroll for salary processing.

* Overall performance evaluation reports
* JD\-based role evaluation reports

* Supervise maintenance of disciplinary registers and warning trackers.
* Lead investigations into serious misconduct cases.
* Conduct counseling sessions and corrective action planning.
* Recommend disciplinary actions to management.
* Ensure fair and consistent application of company policies.

8\. Policy Implementation \& SOP Governance

* Implement HR policies and ensure consistent enforcement.
* Communicate policy updates and HR circulars.
* Review and improve SOPs related to attendance, discipline, and conduct.

* Identify training needs based on evaluations and operational feedback.
* Plan induction and role\-specific training programs.
* Guide and mentor the HR Executive.
* Review HR Executive performance and provide feedback.

* Review resignations and exit formalities.
* Approve full \& final settlements.
* Conduct or review exit interviews and attrition analysis.

We are seeking an enthusiastic HR Intern to join our team and provide invaluable support to our HR department. Your role will involve performing a variety of administrative tasks, including updating employee records, screening resumes, and scheduling interviews.

This internship offers an excellent opportunity to gain firsthand experience in HR operations and gain insight into our company’s approach to payroll, recruiting, and employee development.

As an HR Intern, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the smooth running of our HR policies and procedures. Your attention to detail and organizational skills will be utilized in maintaining accurate employee records and assisting with various HR\-related activities.

Additionally, you will have the chance to contribute to the coordination of company events and gain exposure to different facets of HR management.

If you are eager to kickstart your HR career and work in a dynamic environment that values growth and development, we look forward to meeting you and providing you with a valuable learning experience.

Join our team and embark on a rewarding journey in the field of Human Resources.

Responsibilities

* Update our internal databases with new employee information, including contact details and employment forms
* Gather payroll data like leaves, working hours and bank accounts
* Screen resumes and application forms
* Schedule and confirm interviews with candidates
* Post, update and remove job ads from job boards, careers pages and social networks
* Prepare HR\-related reports as needed (like training budgets by department)
* Address employee queries about benefits (like number of remaining vacation days)
* Review and distribute company policies in digital formats or hard copies
* Participate in organizing company events and careers days

Requirements and skills

* Experience with MS Office
* Good understanding of full\-cycle recruiting
* Organizational skills

description:
Have you ever wondered how the physical goods we consume daily (dairy, snacks, or your favourite choco chip ice cream) reach you in time? Or how elegant furniture, electronic equipment, and gadgets you use are delivered in the best possible condition at your doorstep.
   

  

 Their journey spans from getting sourced, manufactured, and stored to getting moved in a highly intricate supply chain network across the globe before it gets delivered. Global brands face the major challenge of not having visibility of their raw materials, which delays production and, in turn, delays customer shipments or tracking shipments across various modalities and multiple geographies.
   

  

 Intugine Technologies is one of the most trusted solution partners catering to global brands. Our best\-in\-class visibility platform helps brands gain comprehensive visibility over their supply chain across modalities(air/land/sea/rail). Our solutions have helped eliminate operational inefficiencies, reduce logistics costs, improve OTIF, order to delivery TAT, minimise dwell time and detention costs.
   

  

 Intugine is a proud partner of the National Logistics Policy, an initiative by the Government of India. With this, we provide brands with additional information via their integrations with FASTag, Port Community System, and Freight Operations Information System.
   

  

 Today Intugine works with 75\+ global enterprises like GE Healthcare, Signify, Flipkart, Mahindra Logistics, Titan, Diageo, Ultratech Cement, Bridgestone, and GMMCO.
   

  

 To know more, visit the website: https://www.intugine.com
   

  

 Role:
   

  

 We are seeking a motivated and enthusiastic HR Intern to join our Human Resources team. This internship offers an excellent opportunity to gain hands\-on experience in various HR functions and contribute to the success of our organization.
   

  

 Role and Responsibilities
   

  

 The HR Intern will assist the Human Resources department in various tasks and projects to support the overall HR functions. This internship will provide valuable exposure to HR practices, policies, and procedures. The HR Intern will work closely with HR professionals and gain practical knowledge in areas such as recruitment, employee relations, training and development, and HR administration.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

* Recruitment Support:
+ Assist in posting job openings on job boards and company websites.
+ Screen resumes and applications to identify potential candidates.
+ Schedule interviews and communicate with candidates.
+ Assist in conducting initial phone screenings.

* Employee Onboarding:
+ Help prepare new hire paperwork and documentation.
+ Assist in coordinating orientation sessions for new employees.
+ Maintain employee records and ensure accuracy.

* HR Administration:
+ Support HR personnel in maintaining HR files and records.
+ Assist in data entry and updates in the HRIS (Human Resources Information System).
+ Help with maintaining and updating HR policies and procedures.

* Employee Relations:
+ Assist in organizing employee engagement activities and events.
+ Help in resolving minor employee inquiries and issues.
+ Maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive HR information with care.

* Learning and Development:
+ Assist in organizing training programs and workshops.
+ Coordinate training logistics, including scheduling and materials preparation.
+ Track employee training records.

* Other HR Projects:
+ Participate in HR projects and initiatives as assigned.
+ Provide support in HR research and data analysis.


 Qualifications:
   

  

* Currently pursuing a Masters or MBA degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Previous experience in HR and recruitment activities
* Strong interest in pursuing a career in Human Resources.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Detail\-oriented with strong organizational skills.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* A proactive and self\-motivated attitude.
* Willingness to learn and adapt to new tasks and responsibilities.
* Ability to work effectively both independently and in a team.


 Benefits:
   

  

* Hands\-on experience in various HR functions.
* Exposure to real\-world HR challenges and problem\-solving.
* Networking opportunities within the HR field.
* Mentorship and guidance from experienced HR professionals.
